judged_text: isTeamAdminOrOwner combines isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && instead of ||, so only users who are simultaneously admin AND owner pass the check. A user who is a team admin but not the team owner (and not the organizer or an attendee) gets a FORBIDDEN error when adding guests to their team's booking — the documented access path silently fails; the auth check is stricter than the intent, and plain admins are locked out.

record.issue_text: [BUG] isTeamAdminOrOwner combines isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && instead of ||, so only users who are simultaneously admin AND owner pass the check. A user who is a team admin but not the team owner (and not the organizer or an attendee) gets a FORBIDDEN error when adding guests to their team's booking — the documented access path silently fails; the auth check is stricter than the intent, and plain admins are locked out.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. This requires the user to be both admin and owner to pass, contradicting the variable name and the intended “admin OR owner” access path. As a result, a plain team admin who is neither the organizer nor an attendee will hit the `FORBIDDEN` branch (`if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)`).
